best_idea: Collect near-simultaneous hit or spell cues for about 60 ms, play only the highest-priority one, let a playing cue block equal or lower priority for 0.5 s, and attenuate by the count of fresh cues so a burst does not stack into noise.
decision_why: Take the cue slot and the stacking gain for hit and spell cues; drop the cocos and desktop split and the sequence dedupe; sound stays client-only, so the cue trigger comes from server-verified fight events.
acceptance: Three hits landing in one 60 ms window play one hit cue, the heaviest; a higher-priority finisher cue cuts into a playing hit cue; a CueSlot unit test asserts three requests inside 0.06 s give one start and a lower-priority request during the 0.5 s block is dropped.
